name: @mailbowox/core-native
description: UniFFI bindings for the mailbowox core

scripts.ubrn:web: ubrn build wasm2 --config ubrn.config.yaml --profile wasm && wasm-opt -Oz --skip-pass=inlining-optimizing --skip-pass=memory-packing src/generated-web/mailbowox_core.wasm -o src/generated-web/mailbowox_core.wasm && pnpm sql:web
scripts.ubrn:clean: rm -rf cpp android ios src/generated src/generated-web src/index.tsx src/NativeCoreNative.ts build *.podspec
scripts.sql:web: cargo build -p mailbowox-sql-worker --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --profile wasm --manifest-path ../../Cargo.toml && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir src/generated-web/sql-worker ../../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/wasm/mailbowox_sql_worker.wasm && wasm-opt -Oz src/generated-web/sql-worker/mailbowox_sql_worker_bg.wasm -o src/generated-web/sql-worker/mailbowox_sql_worker_bg.wasm

author: Erwan Leboucher
